notes.title: Labophobia | Release 05
notes.notes: [b]Labophobia Release 05[/b] is an update that fixes several bugs and brings minor improvements. This update also adds a guide for new players, as well as graphical improvements to certain interfaces and menus that include text.

notes.title: Labophobia | Release 04
notes.notes:
[b]Labophobia Release 04[/b] is an update that corrects several bugs and improves the game by adding new features.

[i]Next update: A tutorial will be added in the next update (Release 05).[/i]
